description: Granblue Fantasy battle systems: Battle System 1.0 (V1) vs Battle System 2.0 (V2), Omens, and Guard mechanics.

mechanics.chargeDiamonds: Diamonds fill by 1 each turn. Boss executes special attack when all diamonds are full.

modeBar.overdrive: Triggered when boss takes sustained damage; special attacks become enhanced (OD special).
modeBar.break: Triggered when overdrive gauge is fully depleted; boss cannot charge diamonds and takes bonus damage.

mechanics.breakAssassin: Skills providing massive damage bonus strictly while the boss is in Break state.

omens.description: Visual telegraph (予兆) announcing upcoming special attacks and required cancel conditions.

cancelConditions.counterStrategy: Multi-hit skills, echoing normal attacks, triple attack buffs.
Full chain ougi, high-multiplier nukes, assassin buffs.

cancelConditions.sampleRequirement: Activate 4 Damage Skills, 3 Buff Skills, or 3 Debuffs

cancelConditions.counterStrategy: Accumulate 4-ougi bursts to fill 30-100% FC bar.

guard.description: Individual character toggle reducing incoming damage by 80% to 99% while forfeiting that character's action.

fatalChain.description: Special gauge charged by chaining character charge attacks (10% per ougi, bonus on full chain). Discharges a high-damage party elemental nuke and fulfills V2 omens.
